- From premise 2 (Q → P) and Q being true, by **Modus Ponens**, we conclude **P** is true.
- Premise 1 (P ∨ Q) is satisfied since both P and Q are true.

The most specific and non-trivial conclusion derivable from these premises is **P**.

<answer>P</answer>
